summary: Verified the current Prometeo Live page-shelf v2 implementation against the mobile contract without product mutation. The current gh-pages index includes the root drawer, active/stored groups, inline viewer, external-open fallback, and viewer context-menu/folder controls. Exact current pages.js and pages.css blobs were copied from gh-pages, Git blob-hash matched locally (a575d66d816d713cedeadbc436f0e2fef2541463 and d4f3ce2829bb895b6357cdabebd9c0cc8cee6293), then executed in Chromium at 320x720 against DOM IDs matching the current index and a controlled page-watch fixture. The flow passed: no page-wide overflow, first-load baseline creates no historical unread spam, active-page choice persists, a changed revision creates an unread badge, opening that page marks the exact revision seen, viewer/back restores unlocked state, folders render, and the current viewer hamburger opens only the current folder then returns to the root drawer. gh-pages live/pages.json and main PAGE_WATCH_REGISTRY_V1.json are byte-identical at blob e32350c2fe5c6daad563a7b0686b6942c1ed0383. Public /wc source binds PAGE_WATCH_PROTOCOL_V1. Direct network navigation to GitHub Pages from this worker's Chromium was blocked by environment policy (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR), so no independent transport/Served/Human Accepted inference is made.
tests: EXACT_BLOB_IDENTITY: git hash-object on the executed pages.js copy = a575d66d816d713cedeadbc436f0e2fef2541463; executed pages.css copy = d4f3ce2829bb895b6357cdabebd9c0cc8cee6293, matching current gh-pages blobs.
CHROMIUM_320x720: exact page-shelf JS/CSS executed with current-index DOM contract; document/body scrollWidth stayed 320 at root, open drawer, context-folder drawer and after viewer back.
FIRST_LOAD_BASELINE: baseline flag set, all fixture revisions marked seen, unread badge remained empty.
ACTIVE_PERSISTENCE: toggling calendar wrote active-pages storage and reconstructed calendar under Active after DOM/script reload.
REVISION_NOTIFICATION: changing only calendar's stored seen revision produced badge=1 and pageNew; opening calendar updated seen to catalog-20260901-calendar and cleared badge.
VIEWER_BACK_EXTERNAL: opening calendar set viewer title/external target, body lock; viewer Back closed viewer and restored body unlocked.
FOLDER_CONTEXT: from open calendar, viewer menu opened folderMode=Herramientas with 2 fixture rows and current row marked; drawer root control returned to Páginas.
REGISTRY_PARITY: gh-pages live/pages.json and main PAGE_WATCH_REGISTRY_V1.json share exact blob SHA e32350c2fe5c6daad563a7b0686b6942c1ed0383.
WC_BINDING: public gh-pages wc/index.html explicitly requires PAGE_WATCH_PROTOCOL_V1 for material human-visible page changes.

NETWORK_LIMIT: direct Chromium navigation to https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/live/ failed with environment ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR; no public transport success claim is inferred from the source/runtime test.
unresolved: The worker runtime could not independently navigate GitHub Pages over HTTP due administrator network policy; Served/Human Accepted remain outside this return's authority and evidence.
